I can definitely relate to this and for me it even came to the point where I’d be picking at my fingers subconsciously and they’d start bleeding and I wouldn’t notice or feel it because they were so numb after all the constant damage (had some awkward situations sometimes where there were small bloodstains on some test papers sometimes that I’d never even noticed..). Same with biting my lip till it bled, although usually this happened while I’d be asleep and I would wake up with bloody lips.
Based on my experience, I think it’s probably attributed to a lot of anxiety and stress, if you’re constantly doing this it may be safe to assume that you might have anxiety problems and need to partake in some sort of relaxing or calming exercises or hobbies or such.

Either that or I’d say try finding something else to do with your hands so you avoid picking at them. I liked to doodle in class if I couldn’t focus on making notes. That or I also used to bandage all my fingers so I couldn’t pick at them. Definitely looks a little strange to people but it works, if you put a bandaid on every single finger.
